goal: Stable low-cost directional fourth-cumulant regeneration; optimize measured adjusted score with offline heuristics, no inference sampling.
search_execution_note: Use eight rather than four development MLPs per trial to keep eight workers x four threads occupied. The allowed development pool and untouched final protocol are unchanged; no final predictions inspected.
mini_note: All mini data has been inspected in previous work. Only fresh final networks are untouched tests. Validation may choose among a few development finalists, never final seeds.
final_reference_use: Generate reference statistics independently while developing; freeze one candidate before evaluating predictions on final networks. No final-data tuning or repeat selection.
runtime: 8 processes x 4 BLAS threads for offline candidate evaluation; single-thread official subprocess safety verification; RTX5090 for reference Monte Carlo only.
acceptance: Finite predictions, budget/wall/residual/memory safety, validation gain, then paired improvement on untouched final networks; otherwise retain baseline.
